notablePrerequisites: Vhati il-Dal and Tree of Redemption do not have summoning sickness.
description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing Tree of Redemption to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, swapping your life total with Tree of Redemption's toughness.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.
